description_en: Invokes the CreateTransitRouterVbrAttachment operation to connect a Virtual Border Router (VBR) network instance to a transit router instance in the same region. After the connection is established, the transit router can help you achieve private network peering
description_zh: 您可以调用CreateTransitRouterVbrAttachment接口将要互通的边界路由器VBR（Virtual Border Router）网络实例连接到同地域的转发路由器实例中。连接后，转发路由器可帮您实现私网互通
kebab_example: aliyun cbn create-transit-router-vbr-attachment --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vbr-id vbr-bp1svadp4lq38janc0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateTransitRouterVbrAttachment

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance ID
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en: The Enterprise Edition transit router instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 企业版转发路由器实例ID
parameters.name: transit_router_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VBR instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
VBR实例所属地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the VBR connection.

The name can be empty or 1 to 128 characters in length, and cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh:
VBR连接名称。

名称可以为空或长度为1～128个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
parameters.name: transit_router_attachment_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the VBR connection.

The description can be empty or 1 to 256 characters in length, and cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh:
VBR连接描述。

描述可以为空或长度为1～256个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
parameters.name: transit_router_attachment_description

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that owns the VBR instance. The default value is the Alibaba Cloud account ID of the current logon account.

This parameter is required if you want to load a network instance that belongs to a different account
parameters.help_zh:
VBR实例所属阿里云账号（主账号）ID。默认值为当前登录的阿里云账号ID。

如果您要加载跨账号的网络实例，本参数必填
parameters.name: vbr_owner_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to allow the Enterprise Edition transit router to automatically publish route entries to the VBR instance.

false (default): no.
true: yes
parameters.help_zh:
是否使企业版转发路由器自动发布路由到VBR实例。

false（默认值）：否。
true：是
parameters.name: auto_publish_route_enabled

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run, including permission and instance status verification. Valid values:

false (default): sends a normal request. If the request passes the check, the VBR connection is created.
true: sends a check request. Only verification is performed without creating the VBR connection. The system checks whether required parameters are specified and whether the request format is valid. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the corresponding request ID is returned
parameters.help_zh:
是否对此次请求执行预检，包括权限、实例状态校验等。取值：

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接创建VBR连接。
true：发送检查请求，只进行校验，不会创建VBR连接。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回对应请求ID
parameters.name: dry_run

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource.

Once specified, the tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length, and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, or contain `http://` or `https://`.

You can specify up to 20 tag keys at a time
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。

一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`或者`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https:// `。

一次最多支持输入20个标签的标签键
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource.

Once specified, the tag value cannot be empty. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length, and cannot start with aliyun or acs:, or contain http:// or https://.

Each tag key corresponds to one tag value. You can specify up to 20 tag values at a time
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。

一旦传入该值，则不允许为空。支持输入不超过 128 个字符的字符串，不能以 aliyun 或者 acs:开头，不能包含 http://或者 https:// 。

每一个标签键对应一个标签值，一次最多支持输入 20 个标签键对应的标签值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The tag information.

You can specify up to 20 tags at a time
parameters.help_zh:
标签信息。

一次最多支持输入20个标签信息
parameters.name: tag

TransitRouterAttachmentId.description_en: The ID of the VBR connection
